Usage: nodetool [options] [command]

CLI for things

Options:
  -V, --version             output the version number
  -e, --env <environment>   environment (choices: "dev", "prod", default: "dev")
  -d, --debug               output extra debugging
  -h, --help                display help for command

Commands:
  init [options] <name>     create a project
  run|r <script>            run a script
  help [command]            display help for command
